findings.summary: Generated Library filter href can exceed the module's own remembered href limit.
findings.consequence: A paste containing many valid long work ids can route to a Library URL that `rememberedLibraryHref` later refuses, so the shell's remembered Library shortcut can fall back to `/bibliotek` instead of preserving the current filtered page.
findings.evidence: Line 18 returns the generated href without checking `MAX_LIBRARY_HREF_LENGTH`; 100 valid 99-character ids produce an 11,638-character href, while `rememberedLibraryHref` rejects values over 8,192 characters in the same module.
findings.recommendation: Construct the href into a local variable and return `href.length <= MAX_LIBRARY_HREF_LENGTH ? href : null`, or reduce the accepted `workIds` boundary so every accepted input produces a rememberable href.
